# BlockBounce

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** BlockBounce

## What it does

BlockBounce gives you extra upward momentum every time you jump off a bouncy block, letting you launch much higher than vanilla mechanics allow. It's useful on parkour servers, bounce-pad maps, or any time you want to reach ledges and gain height quickly from slime, beds, or honey.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/blockbounce). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
